reasoning: A 3-regular graph on 11 vertices would have sum of degrees = 33, which is odd. Since the sum of degrees must equal 2|E| (even), no such graph exists.
cot_trace: A 3-regular graph on 11 vertices would require the sum of all degrees to equal 33, which is odd—but the handshaking lemma tells us the sum of degrees must always be even, so this is impossible.
